capabilities: Format all code blocks in the active note
Format the code block at the cursor
Run clang-format automatically on explicit save
Configure clang-format executable, style, and .clang-format config file
Test the clang-format setup from settings
extras: Desktop-only (uses Node child processes); not yet in the community directory and must be installed manually.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to format code inside fenced blocks, so code snippets pasted into notes stay unformatted.

relations.evidence: the same approach the Linter plugin uses

summary: Code formatter that runs clang-format on fenced code blocks (C/C++, Java, JS, JSON, protobuf, Verilog, and more) in notes.
